agenda_place: Council Chambers, Municipal Hall, 37955 Second Avenue
preview: This short morning meeting is mostly a closed session, where council will talk privately about a staff or appointment matter, a legal case or possible lawsuit, and legal advice. In the open part, council will also name which councillors act as mayor in December 2026 and January 2027.

agenda_items.plain: Council will vote to close the meeting to the public to discuss a person being considered for a District position, a legal case or possible lawsuit, and advice from its lawyers.
Council will vote to name Councillor Andersen as acting mayor (the councillor who fills in when the mayor is away) for December 2026 and Councillor Ellis for January 2027.
